## Description

Tomorrow's appointments show a risk label (Low, Medium, High) with the reasons in words (past no-shows, booking lead time, unconfirmed). The desk decides whether to call; nothing is sent automatically.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The label is shown as an AI draft (DESIGN.md principle 8) with its reasons.
- [ ] **AC2.** With fewer than 3 months of clinic history the label is not shown.

## Notes / open questions

- Pick up from DentalERP: the input factors in no-show-predictor.ts; start with those rules before any model.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
